description:
About the Scholarship

EMGS is the long-running Erasmus Mundus master in global studies coordinated from Leipzig with partners including Vienna, Wrocław, Roskilde and global network universities. Recent cycles used a 28 February scholarship deadline with a 31 May window for all other applicants, and the 2027 round is expected to match.

OpportunityEMGS – European Master in Global Studies (Erasmus Mundus)
HostEMGS Consortium (University of Leipzig)
LocationLeipzig (multi-country mobility), Germany
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application Deadline28 February 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EMGS is the long-running Erasmus Mundus master in global studies coordinated from Leipzig with partners including Vienna, Wrocław, Roskilde and global network universities. Recent cycles used a 28 February scholarship deadline with a 31 May window for all other applicants, and the 2027 round is expected to match.

Programme Highlights

  • Leipzig-led global studies programme with European and overseas mobility
  • February scholarship deadline with a generous May window for self-funded places
  • Interdisciplinary curriculum across sociology, politics and area studies
  • Strong doctoral progression into globalisation research

Who Should Apply

Social-science and humanities graduates with a globalisation research interest; English plus a second language documentation may apply depending on the pathway.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students in the February round: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply on the EMGS portal; scholarship candidates should target the late-February window and self-funded applicants can wait until May. Key deadline information: 28 February 2027 (scholarship round, expected — the 2026 round closed on this date); 31 May 2027 for all other applicants.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EMGS Consortium (University of Leipzig)

The EMGS consortium is coordinated by the University of Leipzig and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Global Studies with European and global partner universities.

Official website: https://globalstudies-masters.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 28 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
